title.narrative: Strenghtening womens rights and womens participation in North Macedonia (Ktk)
Stärka kvinnors rättigheter och kvinnors deltagande i Nordmakedonien (Ktk)

description.narrative:
Kvinna till Kvinna har ansökt om finansiering på 18 500 000 SEK för att genomföra projektet "Strenghtening womens rights and womens participation in North Macedonia" under perioden 2020-2023.
Det övergripande målet för projektet är att Kvinna till Kvinna och dess lokala partnerorganisationer ska påverka politik och praxis när det gäller könsbaserat våld, agendan för kvinnor, fred och säkerhet (WPS-agendan) och kvinnors ekonomiska befogenheter i Nordmakedonien.
Projektet presenterar fyra delmål - ett för vart och ett av de tre tematiska områdena och ett fjärde som täcker alla områden:
1. Partnerorganisationer bidrar till bättre tillgång till rättslig prövning för rättighetsbärare och rättsstatsprinciper genom policy- och attitydförändringar avseende genusbaserat våld. 2. Partnerorganisationer skapar förutsättningar för kvinnor och flickor att delta fullt och effektivt i utvecklingen av ett jämlikt och demokratiskt samhälle och för genomförandet av agendan för kvinnor, fred och säkerhet (WPS-agendan). 3. Organisationer som nås inom projektet bidrar till förändringar i politik och praxis när det gäller kvinnors ekonomiska bemyndigande. 4. Ett mer levande civilsamhälle genom ökad hållbarhet för organisationer som fokuserar på kvinnors rättigheter.
Projektet kommer att genomföras av Kvinna till Kvinna i samarbete med relevanta partnerorganisationer.
Sida är den enda givaren som har blivit tillfrågad om att ge stöd till denna insats.

Kvinna till kvinna has applied to the Embassy of Sweden for funding of 18,5 MSEK to carry out the project "Strenghtening womens rights and womens participation in North Macedonia" during the period 2020-2023.
The overall objective of the project is that Kvinna till Kvinna and partner organisations will influence policy and practice regarding gender-based violence, the women peace and security agenda and women’s economic empowerment in North Macedonia.
The project presents four intermediate objectives - one for each of the three thematic areas and a fourth covering all areas:
1. Partner organisations contribute to better access to justice for rights holders and rule of law through policy and attitude changes regarding GBV. 2. Partner organisations create conditions for women and girls to participate fully and effectively in the development of an equal and democratic society, and towards the implementation of the women, peace and security agenda. 3. Organisations reached within the program contribute to changes in policy and practice regarding women’s economic empowerment. 4. A more vibrant civil society through increased sustainability of women’s rights organisations.
The project will be implemented by Kvinna till Kvinna in collaboration with relevant partner organisations.
Sida is the only donor invited by Kvinna till kvinna for support of this intervention.

The overall objective of the project was that Kvinna till Kvinna and local partner organisations influenced policy and practice regarding gender-based violence, the women peace and security agenda and women's economic empowerment in North Macedonia. By working towards this objective, the project aimed to contribute to the long-term outcome that: North Macedonia is a democratic society where women rights and participation is secured, with a vibrant and pluralistic civil society. The project presents four intermediate objectives - one for each of the three thematic areas and a fourth covering all areas.
Programme objective was that Kvinna till Kvinna and partner organizations influence policy and practice regarding gender-based violence, the women, peace and security agenda, and women economic empowerment in North Macedonia.
The four intermediate objectives were:
- Partner organizations contribute to better access to justice for rights holders and rule of law through policy and attitude changes regarding Gender Based Violence (GBV). - Partner organizations create conditions for women and girls to participate fully and effectively in the development of an equal and democratic society, and towards the implementation of the women, peace, and security agenda. - Organizations reached within the program contribute to changes in policy and practice regarding women economic empowerment. - A more vibrant civil society through increased sustainability of women rights organizations.
Under the area of women, peace and security focus was placed on increasing participation of women in decision-making at national and local level, on promoting feminist peace in different fora, both local, national and international; providing safe spaces for Women Human Right Defenders (WHRDs) and Women CSOs to discuss and plan strategies and advocacy actions related to safety and security for WHRDs while countering the anti-gender movement. The work on women participation in policy-and decision-making, was especially implemented at local levels.
Through the support to and cooperation with partner organisations, Kvinna till Kvinna used advocacy to influence relevant stakeholders at local, national and international level. Apart from advocacy, the main methods that Kvinna till Kvinna used to reach the programme goals were financial and political support to women rights organisations, capacity development, networking, communication and outreach. The target groups of the intervention were manifold - both at local and national levels as well as targeting the public. For instance, the project aimed to have an influence on local municipalities, mayors and civil society organisations, as well as national government, ministries and intersectoral working groups.
The project was Agreed for implementing period 1st December 2020 to 31st December 2023, and cost-extended until 30 September 2024. In continuity and based on the findings and recommendations of the external project evaluation, second Amendment to the Agreement was signed agreeing on cost-extension for extended project implementation period until 31st March 2025.Throughout the cost-extension period the vital and necessary support to partner organizations was continued.
The total project budget for the period 1st December 2020 - 31st March 2025 was 27 mSEK.

tag.narrative: 5.1 - Avskaffa alla former av diskriminering av alla kvinnor och flickor överallt
5.1 - End all forms of discrimination against all women and girls everywhere.
5.2 - Avskaffa alla former av våld mot alla kvinnor och flickor i det offentliga och privata rummet, inklusive människohandel, sexuellt utnyttjande och andra typer av exploatering.
5.2 - Eliminate all forms of violence against all women and girls in the public and private spheres, including trafficking and sexual and other types of exploitation.
5.5 - Ensure women’s full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making in political, economic and public life.
5.5 - Tillförsäkra kvinnor fullt och faktiskt deltagande och lika möjligheter till ledarskap på alla beslutsnivåer i det politiska, ekonomiska och offentliga livet.
5.c - Adopt and strengthen sound policies and enforceable legislation for the promotion of gender equality and the empowerment of all women and girls at all levels.
5.c - Anta och stärka välgrundad politik och genomförbar lagstiftning för att främja jämställdhet och öka alla kvinnors och flickors egenmakt på alla nivåer
